findings_disposition.pinky: Measured orthogonal backbone; R0.8 blends retained.
findings_disposition.links_fit: Clear labels, selection/empty feedback; camera uses actual canvas size, pixel framing tested.
findings_disposition.explorer: Padded full-row hover, explicit eyes, per-piece controls, Solo/Show all; occluded hover is temporary X-ray.
findings_disposition.view: All 9 controls remain outside inspector; tested during collapse and mobile layouts.

retrospective.trigger: User annotated thumb protrusion/angular lower edge and ambiguous controls; follow-up requested per-piece visibility and occlusion highlight.
retrospective.cause: Previous face-offset contour allowed its angled outer thumb to exceed LCD flank; matching constant-thumb-margin tests constrained the newly requested curve. Control semantics and group eyes were insufficiently discoverable.
retrospective.correction: Local geometric replacement and explicit persistent/explorer controls.
retrospective.prevention: Retained former geometry fixtures; actual CAD flank/native-curve checks, computed pinky angles, rendered fit and occluded-hover pixel tests, and per-object/solo visibility acceptance.
